keyword_screen.method: Author enumerated PDF37-48 spans, fonts, bounding boxes and annotations; visually inspected all twelve full-page rasters. Checked MinionPro-Bold/BoldIt/It and Myriad heading/table families plus publisher-shaded tables, not merely bold body names. Tried equipment rows, named complication/agent terms, meaningful headings and lexical headwords inside full emphasized sentences. Mapped repeated/expanded variants to entries. Excluded prose relationships, numbers, navigation and generic organizational wording only after extracting meaningful lexical heads. This is a substantial bounded screen, not proof of every table comment/body word or exhaustive clinical coverage; no OCR or empirical salience ranking.
